accepts.description: Zero-signup web scraping, HTML-to-JSON extraction & compliance checks ($0.01 USDC on Base or 1 prepaid credit).

description: Convert raw text, email bodies, receipts, logs, or HTML snippets already in memory into strict typed JSON conforming to target_schema. Use when you already have the source text and need deterministic schema enforcement without burning local reasoning tokens. Strictly capped at 6,000 bytes.

raw_text.description: Unstructured text, HTML fragment, or document snippet to normalize (max 6,000 bytes).

target_schema.description: Declarative key-type map defining the exact JSON structure to return.

name: extract_structured_data
